title: Fix profile photo reliability; add weekly study time graph; enable edit/delete for reminders and tasks with accurate in-app notifications

requirements.text: Fix the profile photo (avatar) feature end-to-end so that uploading a profile photo from the Profile page reliably persists and renders as the user’s avatar, including after reload and after logging out + logging back in.

quotes: Still profile photo is not working as expected.

acceptanceCriteria: From the Profile page, selecting an image and saving updates the user profile and shows the new avatar immediately.
After a full page reload, the avatar still displays the uploaded image (not the fallback).
After logging out and logging back in, the avatar still displays the uploaded image.
If upload/persist fails for any reason, the UI shows a clear error message and the previous avatar remains unchanged.

requirements.text: Add a weekly study-time graph in the authenticated UI that shows minutes studied for the last 7 days, including (1) a combined total across Pomodoro + Custom timer + Stopwatch and (2) a per-mode breakdown so Pomodoro, Custom, and Stopwatch minutes are distinguishable.

quotes: Also add we can see weekly graph that we can see how many minutes we studied with pomodoro and custom together and stopwatch different.
we can see weekly study time graph.

acceptanceCriteria: The UI displays a 7-day view (including day labels) with minutes studied per day.
The UI provides a combined total view and a breakdown by mode (Pomodoro vs Custom vs Stopwatch).
The data used in the graph is persisted and is consistent after reload/log out + log in.
Days with zero study show as 0 minutes (no missing days).

requirements.text: Add support to edit and delete reminders from the Reminders UI, persisting changes in the backend and keeping the list of upcoming reminders in sync via existing React Query invalidation.

quotes: we can delete and edit remainders

acceptanceCriteria: Each reminder in the Upcoming Reminders list has actions to Edit and Delete.
Editing a reminder allows updating at least the title and reminder date/time, and the updated reminder appears correctly in the list after saving.
Deleting a reminder removes it from the list and it does not reappear after reload.
Backend enforces that a user can only edit/delete their own reminders.

requirements.text: Ensure reminders trigger an in-app browser notification at the reminder time as accurately as possible while the app is open, and avoid duplicate notifications for the same reminder.

quotes: they'll send notification at the time of remainder
Reminders should send a notification at the correct time.

acceptanceCriteria: When the current time reaches a reminder’s scheduled time (while the app is open), the app shows a browser notification for that reminder.
Notifications do not fire more than once per reminder.
If notification permissions are not granted, the app presents a clear, user-facing message prompting the user to enable notifications, and reminders still remain visible in the list.

requirements.text: Add support to edit and delete tasks in the Tasks (Todo) UI, persisting changes in the backend and keeping the tasks list in sync via existing React Query invalidation.

quotes: also task can also be edited and deleted

acceptanceCriteria: Each task has actions to Edit and Delete.
Editing supports updating at minimum: title; and also updates description, subject, and priority if present.
Deleting a task removes it from the list and it does not reappear after reload.
Backend enforces that a user can only edit/delete their own tasks.

requirements.text: Allow tasks to be unselected (i.e., completion can be toggled both directions) so a user can mark a task completed and later mark it as not completed again.
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking the task completion checkbox toggles between completed and not completed.
A completed task can be returned to the Pending list after being unselected.
The completion state persists after reload.

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor with all logic in backend/main.mo.
Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui or other frontend immutable paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
User-facing text must be in English.
Do not add real-time infrastructure (no WebSockets/push notifications); reminder notifications must be limited to what a web app can do while open.
nonGoals: Implementing OS-level push notifications or notifications when the browser/app is fully closed.
Adding third-party analytics or external databases to store graph data.
Changing timetable entry editing/deletion/tickbox/history behavior (already covered by existing features).
